Coverage

Robinhood’s direct Ethereum-settled L2 and identifiable bridge activity. Its observed contracts begin April 30, 2026, before mainnet launch. Six-month averages include earlier days with no observed attributable activity. Arbitrum One activity is not allocated to Robinhood.

Execution gas divided by 21,000. This compares gas demand, not transaction usefulness.
